hook_patterns: question‑or‑challenge opening that promises a surprising answer
numbered list or “X signs/facts” that promises quick, digestible nuggets
visual metaphor or vivid contrast that sparks curiosity instantly
todays_angle: Leverage a timeless psychology concept as a bold, list‑style myth‑busting short.
ideas: "3 Ancient Stoic Tricks to Rewire Your Brain in 30 Seconds" – animate key Stoic quotes with modern visuals.
"Freud’s Iceberg: 4 Hidden Layers of Your Mind Explained Fast" – use a simple iceberg graphic to illustrate conscious vs. unconscious.
"Skinner’s 5 Everyday Reinforcement Hacks You’re Already Using" – rapid cuts showing daily habits with on‑screen text."
avoid: generic “relationship signs” listicles that are oversaturated
zodiac or birth‑month personality videos that lack scholarly depth
